newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Grupo Carso started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Grupo Carso started.

text.p: -- ING Barings analyst Kathleen Breitenbach has started coverage of Mexican conglomerate Grupo Carso SA de CV with a rating of neutral.
-- The company is a "play on export-led industrial growth and eventual consumer recovery," she wrote in an April 7 report.
-- "Recent acquisition of Sears de Mexico should boost sales and provide a new turnaround project for management," she said.
-- Breitenbach said she expected Carso's stock to appreciate 11 percent by the end of the year.
-- The company's shares were off 0.10 peso to 46.20 pesos in Mexico City.
